summary.text: Simon Trautmann Cordova is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 51, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the seat has no incumbent, and Juline Birgersson (R) is also running.
An attorney and small business owner, he described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a former Richfield City Councilmember.

paragraphs.text: Simon Trautmann Cordova graduated from Richfield High School and received his law degree from the University of St. Thomas School of Law in 2008.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Bloomington, is a lifelong Richfield resident raising his family there, and began his career working at his mother's small business.
He said he has built a mid-sized law firm that represents small businesses and nonprofits.

Trautmann Cordova said in the survey that on the Richfield City Council he instituted language accessibility initiatives, created city-sponsored legal clinics, and helped secure infrastructure funding including for Woodlake Nature Center.

He listed affordability, health care and holding fraudsters accountable among his campaign messages, and said he would champion the Minnesota Health Plan and propose a Universal Primary Care pilot program.
